Name: The Apothecary
Author: OliverOvrTech
Description:
[center][img width=450]https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/1658597/description_90c1404a-03cc-4d7d-9a4c-11d1d6fb505c.png[/img][/center]
[center]The Apothecary adds new skills built around making and using aromatic goods. Explore brand new professions that boost production across multiple base game skills. [/center]
[quote][center][size=5]The Apothecary developed by [url=https://ovrtechnology.com/]OVR Technology[/url] & Mood Studios [/size]
[b]Nexus has reviewed and confirmed no AI usage.[/b]
This mod will never require a purchase to fully experience the mod
[/center]
OVR Technology is a tech company in Burlington, Vermont that makes the Omara Scent Display. The Omara can pair with your games and releases scent in real time. We built this mod because our Scentware Lead truly loves Stardew and has been dreaming about what it would be like to smell her farm.[/quote][size=4][b]How to Install[/b][/size]
Back up your save before installing
[list=1]
[*]Install required mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url] 1.28.4 or newer[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod in the Stardew Valley/Mods folder[/*]
[*]If using scent integration, download [url=https://ovrtechnology.com/pages/omara-scent-studio-app]Omara Scent Studio[/url][/*]
[*]Launch the game[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to Update (Before 1.1.0)[/b][/size]
Back up your save before updating
[list=1]
[*]Go into your mods folder find the StardewMod installation [/*]
[*]Back up your config.json[/*]
[*]Remove the [icode]StardewMod[/icode] installation[/*]
[*]Place the [icode]TheApothecary[/icode] installation & drop the config in the directory[/*]
[*]Any changes will be immediately available[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]New Apothecary skill[/*]
[*]New upgradeable equipment & tools[/*]
[*]Incense Item Type: Boost production/stats for crops, animals, fishing, foraging, etc[/*]
[*]Meet the new NPC Dahlia! The Village's new Apothecary, who lives by the lake in Cindersap Forest. She is not a romanceable character. [/*]
[*]New forageable goods, seeds and crops [/*]
[*]The Great Truffle Hunt, a new festival to explore [/*]
[*]Brand new Arcade minigame [/*]
[*]New items to donate and decorate[/*]
[*]Villagers have toggleable scents when interacted with[/*]
[*]Aroma Match's Hardest Difficulty is scent based[/*]
[*]Custom Device tab in Menu[/*]
[*]Custom Scent Log overlay[/*]
[/list]For more information on our [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1F00AYU2i7WHnbEhSSTcJ_BK42YoBVFpr/view]scent list[/url]

[size=4][b]Config Options[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Toggles for visual cues, including the corner label[/*]
[*]Mute debug messages in SMAPI logs (Action, Proximity, & Passive Triggers)[/*]
[*]Debug Scent Log Overlay [/*]
[*]Replay the calibration cinematic[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Compat[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.0+[/*]
[*]Tested with fresh or existing saves [/*]
[*]Tested with SVE, Vanilla Plus Professions, Lionheart, & Walk of Life - Rebirth [/*]
[*]Complete Multiplayer Support [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]How to Uninstall [/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Load the save as the host.[/*]
[*]Run [b]apoth_uninstall[/b] to preview the cleanup[/*]
[*]Run [b]apoth_uninstall confirm[/b] to remove it from your save[/*]
[*]Save the game[/*]
[*]Quit the game[/*]
[*]Delete the [b]Mods/TheApothecary[/b] folder[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Connecting your Omara [/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Open Omara Scent Studio, and connect your Omara [/*]
[*]In Stardew, open your menu and go into the OVR device tab [/*]
[*]Enable the "Connect to Omara" checkbox! [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size]
🇪🇸 Español: ¡Incluido! Solo cambia el idioma del juego a español.

[size=4][b]Bugs & Feedback[/b][/size]
Please include any SMAPI logs so we can better assist

If you need more mod support feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/ovr-omara]Discord[/url] or email us at support@ovrtechnology.com

Downloads.Description:
The Apothecary: Dahlia's requests, scent moments and a new Journal
This update adds requests of Dahlia's own, gives cutscenes, Community Center rooms and other players their own scents, and turns the Apothecary's Journal into Dahlia's notebook.

Manifest.Name: The Apothecary
Manifest.Description: Learn the Apothecary skill and craft incense and remedies. Meet Dahlia at her workshop and join the Great Truffle Hunt. Scent display support is optional.
Manifest.Author: MoodStudios
